name: pixel3d-renderer
description: Pixel-art 3D renderer for three.js games: a library, not an engine.

scripts.build:lib: vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && node tools/lib-types.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:lib && tsc -p test && node --test test/
scripts.build:example: npm run build:lib && tsc -p examples/walker && vite build --config examples/walker/vite.config.ts
scripts.verify: node tools/verify.ts && node tools/check-viewer.ts && node tools/anim-check.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lamp-shadow-check && npm run moving-shadow-check && npm run village-check && npm run resolve-check && npm run window-light-check && npm run water-check && npm run camera-check && npm run object-check && npm run object-motion-check && npm run object-look-check && npm run pick-check && npm run highlight-check && npm run settings-check && npm run startup-check && npm run example-check && npm run golden && npm run verify
